searchText: If last Fulu slot is proposed, and first two post-gloas slots are missed, and third post gloas slot is proposed, it seems CL clients disagree on building on P-FULL vs P-EMPTY. Related issue was closed as not planned. Is this tolerable and something you are aware of? https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/issues/5096 fork choice bug in clients? Looks like. Some clients vote PENDING/EMPTY on pre-gloas payload availability and some (Prysm/Lodestar) vote FULL I am trying to repro locally 🙏 lodestar is passing forkchoice compliance tests, so we should be aligned with spec behavior > Some clients vote PENDING/EMPTY on pre-gloas payload availability pre-gloas is always FULL, so that doesn't make much sense but it might not be well defined in the spec I suppose cc <@755590043632140352> My AI says lighthouse says pre-gloas is PENDING. Dunno what to make of it We received a bounty report demo ing the transient split but still trying to repro we talked about that before, I am surprised this can cause a split but you can also argue pre-gloas is always `PENDING` 😄 so I believe that is the issue here but if last block is pre-gloas, how can you even build on full vs. empty, maybe I don't understand the report properly Isn't it irrelevant? If the vote is for the fulu root PTC is irrelevant thinking the same https://gist.github.com/bshastry/8194d1a10144b85165d6a4d524bc57e0 Run it with: python3 repro-prysm-gloas-issue-428.py --replace The snapshot shows Lighthouse/Teku at slot 10 while Prysm remained at slot 7 from +257 ms through +11.456 s; canonical recovery occurred by slot 12, around +24 s. My AI made this repro. It is a transient split on the pre-configured schedule minimal preset, 8 slots per epoch, fork transition at epoch 1, last fulu slot 7, slots 8/9 missed, and 10 proposed what about lodestar? My ai tells me lodestar and prysm behave similarly But I could only repro a 20s transient split, so not sure this is bounty worthy. What do you think? the first proposed Gloas block is `0xe6590b597bc5f765c9267639e9673df0a6f5b84340ad76961e61aa67fcc7201c` based on what? based on fulu's final slot (pre fork-transition) parent Updated here: https://gist.github.com/bshastry/8194d1a10144b85165d6a4d524bc57e0 slot=7 is final slot of fulu, slots 8 and 9 (first two gloas slots) are intentionally missed. slot 10 builds on slot-7 fulu parent but what's the bug here, sounds correct The claimed bug is the transient fork-choice disagreement after the slot-10 block arrives: the report says the non-Prysm clients select slot 10 while Prysm continues to report slot 7 as head because the post-Gloas attestations for the pre-Gloas root are resolved differently by payload status. My prev run (gist) was buggy because it had inactive stake, am rerunning and will share update 🙏
